333:         Scale degrees extensions for the quality.
334: 
335:     """
336:     return EXTENDED_QUALITY_REDUX.get(quality, (quality, set()))
337: 
338: 
339: # --- Chord Label Parsing ---
340: # This monster regexp is pulled from the JAMS chord namespace,
341: # which is in turn derived from the context-free grammar of
342: # Harte et al., 2005.
343: CHORD_RE = re.compile(
344:     r"""^((N|X)|(([A-G](b*|#*))((:(maj|min|dim|aug|1|5|sus2|sus4|maj6|min6|7|maj7|min7|dim7|hdim7|minmaj7|aug7|9|maj9|min9|11|maj11|min11|13|maj13|min13)(\((\*?((b*|#*)([1-9]|1[0-3]?))(,\*?((b*|#*)([1-9]|1[0-3]?)))*)\))?)|(:\((\*?((b*|#*)([1-9]|1[0-3]?))(,\*?((b*|#*)([1-9]|1[0-3]?)))*)\)))?((/((b*|#*)([1-9]|1[0-3]?)))?)?))$"""
345: )  # nopep8
346: 
347: 
348: def validate_chord_label(chord_label):
349:     """Test for well-formedness of a chord label.
350: 
351:     Parameters
352:     ----------
353:     chord_label : str
354:         Chord label to validate.
355:     """
356:     if not CHORD_RE.match(chord_label):
357:         raise InvalidChordException("Invalid chord label: " "{}".format(chord_label))
358:     pass
359: 
360: 
361: def split(chord_label, reduce_extended_chords=False):
362:     """Parse a chord label into its four constituent parts:
363:         - root
364:         - quality shorthand
365:         - scale degrees
366:         - bass
367: 
368:     Note: Chords lacking quality AND interval information are major.
369:       - If a quality is specified, it is returned.
370:       - If an interval is specified WITHOUT a quality, the quality field is
371:         empty.
372: 
373:     Some examples::
374: 
375:         'C' -> ['C', 'maj', {}, '1']
376:         'G#:min(*b3,*5)/5' -> ['G#', 'min', {'*b3', '*5'}, '5']
377:         'A:(3)/6' -> ['A', '', {'3'}, '6']
378: 
379:     Parameters
380:     ----------
381:     chord_label : str
382:         A chord label.
383:     reduce_extended_chords : bool
384:         Whether to map the upper voicings of extended chords (9's, 11's, 13's)
385:         to semitone extensions. (Default value = False)
386: 
387:     Returns
388:     -------
389:     chord_parts : list
390:         Split version of the chord label.
391: 
392:     """
393:     chord_label = str(chord_label)
394:     validate_chord_label(chord_label)
395:     if chord_label == NO_CHORD:
396:         return [chord_label, "", set(), ""]
397: 
398:     bass = "1"
399:     if "/" in chord_label:
400:         chord_label, bass = chord_label.split("/")
401: 
402:     scale_degrees = set()
403:     omission = False
404:     if "(" in chord_label:
405:         chord_label, scale_degrees = chord_label.split("(")
406:         omission = "*" in scale_degrees
407:         scale_degrees = scale_degrees.strip(")")
408:         scale_degrees = {i.strip() for i in scale_degrees.split(",")}
409: 
410:     # Note: Chords lacking quality AND added interval information are major.
411:     #   If a quality shorthand is specified, it is returned.
412:     #   If an interval is specified WITHOUT a quality, the quality field is
413:     #     empty.
414:     #   Intervals specifying omissions MUST have a quality.
415:     if omission and ":" not in chord_label:
416:         raise InvalidChordException(
417:             "Intervals specifying omissions MUST have a quality."
418:         )
419:     quality = "" if scale_degrees else "maj"
420:     if ":" in chord_label:
421:         chord_root, quality_name = chord_label.split(":")
422:         # Extended chords (with ":"s) may not explicitly have Major qualities,
423:         # so only overwrite the default if the string is not empty.
424:         if quality_name:
425:             quality = quality_name.lower()
426:     else:
427:         chord_root = chord_label
428: 
429:     if reduce_extended_chords:
430:         quality, addl_scale_degrees = reduce_extended_quality(quality)
431:         scale_degrees.update(addl_scale_degrees)
432: 
433:     return [chord_root, quality, scale_degrees, bass]
434: 
435: 
436: def join(chord_root, quality="", extensions=None, bass=""):
437:     r"""Join the parts of a chord into a complete chord label.
438: 
439:     Parameters
440:     ----------
441:     chord_root : str
442:         Root pitch class of the chord, e.g. 'C', 'Eb'
443:     quality : str
444:         Quality of the chord, e.g. 'maj', 'hdim7'
445:         (Default value = '')
446:     extensions : list
447:         Any added or absent scaled degrees for this chord, e.g. ['4', '\*3']
448:         (Default value = None)
449:     bass : str
450:         Scale degree of the bass note, e.g. '5'.
451:         (Default value = '')
452: 
453:     Returns
454:     -------
455:     chord_label : str
456:         A complete chord label.
457: 
458:     """
459:     chord_label = chord_root
460:     if quality or extensions:
461:         chord_label += ":%s" % quality
462:     if extensions:
463:         chord_label += "(%s)" % ",".join(extensions)
464:     if bass and bass != "1":
465:         chord_label += "/%s" % bass
466:     validate_chord_label(chord_label)
467:     return chord_label
468: 
469: 
470: # --- Chords to Numerical Representations ---
471: def encode(chord_label, reduce_extended_chords=False, strict_bass_intervals=False):
472:     """Translate a chord label to numerical representations for evaluation.
473: 
474:     Parameters
475:     ----------
476:     chord_label : str
477:         Chord label to encode.
478:     reduce_extended_chords : bool
479:         Whether to map the upper voicings of extended chords (9's, 11's, 13's)
480:         to semitone extensions.
481:         (Default value = False)
482:     strict_bass_intervals : bool
483:         Whether to require that the bass scale degree is present in the chord.
484:         (Default value = False)
485: 
486:     Returns
487:     -------
488:     root_number : int
